title: Q1
description:
“The word spoken through angels proved steadfast.”
Read: Deut 33:2, Psa 68:17, Act 7:53, Gal 3:19
a) Acts 7:53 and Gal 3:19 say the Law was given through angels; Deut 33:2 (“ten thousands of saints”) and Psa 68:17 (the chariots of God “as in Sinai”) are the OT background. What does that background bring to Hebrews' warning, now that chapter 1 has set the Son above those angels?
